title: Citadel Conference Travel Grant 2026: Fully Funded Conference Travel Support for STEM Students

description:
The  Citadel Conference Travel Grant  is an opportunity designed to support promising students in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) who want to attend leading academic and research conferences around the world.
The program is intended to help rising talent participate in conferences where they can present their research, exchange ideas, connect with researchers and industry professionals, and gain exposure to developments at the forefront of their fields.
For selected applicants, Citadel provides substantial financial support covering major conference-related expenses, including the conference registration or full-access pass, round-trip airfare, accommodation, airport transportation, and a food stipend. Recipients may also have opportunities to attend Citadel-hosted dinners and recruitment events during their chosen conference.
The grant is particularly relevant to students pursuing  mathematics, computer science, physics, statistics, electrical engineering, and other quantitative disciplines .
What Is the Citadel Conference Travel Grant?
The Citadel Conference Travel Grant is a conference funding initiative created to expand opportunities for exceptional students and emerging STEM researchers.
Academic and research conferences are important platforms for students and researchers to:
• Present research findings
• Publish and discuss academic work
• Exchange ideas with experts
• Discover new developments in their disciplines
• Build professional networks
• Meet potential collaborators
• Learn about career opportunities
• Gain exposure to leading organizations and researchers
However, conference attendance can be expensive, particularly for students who need to travel internationally.
The Citadel Conference Travel Grant aims to reduce this financial barrier by providing selected students with comprehensive travel support.
What Does the Citadel Conference Travel Grant Cover?
Selected applicants can receive support for several major expenses associated with attending an eligible conference.
1. Full-Access Conference Pass
Citadel will cover the entire cost of a full-access conference pass for selected applicants.
This allows recipients to participate in the eligible conference without having to personally cover the conference registration cost.
Important:  The full-access conference pass benefit does not apply to the Grace Hopper Celebration.
2. Round-Trip Airfare
Citadel will provide round-trip airfare for selected recipients.
This is particularly valuable for students attending international conferences because airfare can represent a significant portion of the total cost of conference participation.
3. Accommodation
Selected students will receive lodging support for the duration of their conference participation.
The accommodation is arranged through Citadel's designated travel arrangements.
4. Airport and Local Transportation
Recipients will receive travel support for transportation to and from the airport.
Citadel also provides Uber vouchers for transportation during the conference week.
5. Food Stipend
Grant recipients will receive a meal stipend to help cover food expenses during their conference attendance.
Details regarding the food stipend are provided to selected recipients at a later stage.
6. Exclusive Citadel Events
Selected recipients may have the opportunity to participate in Citadel-hosted dinners and recruitment events associated with their chosen conference.

description:
Registrations Are Now Open for Global Model FAO 2026
Students, educators, aspiring diplomats, and global changemakers from around the world now have the opportunity to register for the highly anticipated Global Model FAO 2026 conference. Hosted at the headquarters of the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) in Rome, Italy, this prestigious international event provides participants with a unique opportunity to experience how international negotiations are conducted within one of the world's leading United Nations agencies.
Global Model FAO 2026 offers participants an immersive diplomatic experience where they will represent countries, debate pressing global issues, negotiate policies, and collaborate with delegates from different regions of the world. The conference aims to strengthen participants' understanding of international cooperation while developing practical leadership, communication, negotiation, and policy-making skills.
Whether you are participating as a student delegate, faculty advisor, or observer, Global Model FAO 2026 provides an outstanding platform for learning, networking, and professional development.
What is Global Model FAO?
Global Model FAO is an international simulation of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations. During the conference, participants assume the role of ambassadors and country representatives, engaging in discussions and negotiations on issues affecting agriculture, food systems, rural development, climate resilience, nutrition, and global food security.
Rather than simply observing international diplomacy, participants actively engage in committee sessions that mirror real FAO negotiations. This practical learning experience enables attendees to gain valuable insight into how international organizations work to address global challenges.
Why Participate in Global Model FAO 2026?
Participating in Global Model FAO offers much more than attending a conference. It is an opportunity to build practical diplomatic experience while connecting with participants from diverse academic and cultural backgrounds.
Participants will have the opportunity to:
• Experience realistic United Nations negotiations.
• Represent a country during committee sessions.
• Strengthen diplomacy and public speaking skills.
• Improve negotiation and consensus-building abilities.
• Develop leadership and teamwork competencies.
• Learn about international food security and sustainable agriculture policies.
• Build professional relationships with participants from around the world.
• Experience the atmosphere of FAO Headquarters in Rome.
• Gain exposure to international policymaking processes.
• Enhance academic and professional profiles through participation.
Registration Timeline
Registration for Global Model FAO 2026 is divided into three different phases to accommodate participants who wish to secure their place early.
Early Registration
• Opens:  July 31, 2026
Priority Registration
• Opens:  September 13, 2026
Regular Registration
• Opens:  October 11, 2026
Applicants are encouraged to register as early as possible to maximize the benefits associated with early registration and to ensure smoother conference preparation.
REGISTER AND APPLY HERE
For more information about this conference, visit global model FAO  HERE
Visit OFY Website  HERE  for more conference programs
Individual and Group Registration
Participants have the flexibility to register:
• Individually
• As part of a group or institutional delegat

description:
The Science for Africa Foundation, in partnership with the Mental Health Innovation Network, is offering a limited number of Event Scholarships to support individuals who want to participate in the Global Mental Health in Africa Conference 2027 (#GMHAC2027) but face financial barriers.
The scholarship initiative is designed to ensure that the voices shaping the future of mental health across Africa are represented at one of the continent's leading mental health gatherings. Recognizing that financial constraints often prevent talented researchers, students, practitioners, advocates, and individuals with lived experience from attending international conferences, this scholarship seeks to remove those barriers and promote greater inclusion.
If you are passionate about advancing mental health research, policy, services, or advocacy across Africa, this opportunity could enable you to attend the conference while receiving financial support for key participation expenses.
About the Science for Africa Foundation Event Scholarships
The Science for Africa Foundation and the Mental Health Innovation Network believe that meaningful conversations about mental health in Africa should include the people who are directly involved in improving mental health systems and services across the continent.
Through these scholarships, selected participants will receive financial support that enables them to attend #GMHAC2027 and contribute to discussions on research, innovation, policy, practice, and lived experiences in mental health.
The scholarships are highly competitive, with only a limited number of awards available.
Why These Scholarships Matter
Mental health continues to be one of the most important public health priorities across Africa. However, many talented professionals and advocates are unable to attend major conferences due to financial limitations.
These scholarships aim to:
• Increase African participation in global mental health discussions
• Support early-career professionals developing careers in mental health
• Amplify the voices of people with lived experience
• Encourage collaboration among researchers, practitioners, policymakers, students, and advocates
• Promote stronger community engagement in mental health initiatives
• Build networks that strengthen mental health systems across Africa
Who Can Apply?
The scholarship is open to individuals working in or connected to mental health across Africa.
Eligible applicants include:
1. Early-Career Researchers
Researchers involved in:
• Mental health research
• Public health research
• Clinical research
• Mental health policy
• Mental health practice
2. Students
Students are eligible to apply provided they submit:
• A letter of support from their institution, supervisor, or academic advisor
3. Persons with Lived Experience
Individuals with:
• Personal lived experience of mental health conditions
• Psychosocial disabilities
• Experience contributing to advocacy or community engagement
4. Other Mental Health Professionals
Applicants who have a demonstrated connection to mental health in Africa may also apply.
Examples include individuals working in:
• Mental health advocacy
• Community organizations
• NGOs
• Healthcare delivery
• Government agencies
• Social work
• Psychology
• Psychiatry
• Public health
• Policy development
Applicants should clearly explain their role in the application.

As One Young World's flagship scholarship programme, the Leading Scholarship aims to ensure that exceptional young leaders from countries often underrepresented in global decision-making spaces can participate in one of the world's most influential youth leadership gatherings.
About the One Young World Leading Scholarship 2026
The One Young World Summit brings together thousands of young leaders, entrepreneurs, activists, policymakers, and innovators from across the globe to discuss solutions to the world's most pressing challenges.
The Leading Scholarship identifies and supports young changemakers who have demonstrated outstanding leadership, innovation, and commitment to creating sustainable impact in their communities.
Scholarship Benefits
Successful applicants will receive:

• Be actively addressing local and/or global challenges through their work.
• Have a proven track record of leadership, innovation, and community impact.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

• Any additional visa-related costs.

title: Rockefeller Foundation Bellagio Center Convening Program 2027: Fully Supported Global Convenings for Changemakers Tackling the World’s Biggest Challenges
summary: Applications are now open for the prestigious Rockefeller Foundation Bellagio Center Convening Program 2027, a globally recognized initiative that brings together visionary leaders, organizations, innovators, policymakers, researchers, entrepreneurs, and changemakers from around the world to develop
description:
Applications are now open for the prestigious Rockefeller Foundation Bellagio Center Convening Program 2027, a globally recognized initiative that brings together visionary leaders, organizations, innovators, policymakers, researchers, entrepreneurs, and changemakers from around the world to develop breakthrough solutions to humanity’s most pressing challenges.
For more than six decades, The Rockefeller Foundation Bellagio Center has served as one of the world's leading spaces for collaboration, innovation, and global problem-solving. Located in Bellagio, Italy, the Center has hosted influential convenings that have contributed to transformative initiatives across health, food systems, energy access, finance, climate action, and international development.
The 2027 Bellagio Center Convening Program offers organizations a unique opportunity to host high-impact, one-week convenings designed to accelerate solutions, build strategic partnerships, foster collaboration, and create lasting global impact.
Each year, approximately 1,000 participants attend around 60 Bellagio convenings, making the program one of the most influential global platforms for advancing ideas that can improve lives worldwide.
About The Rockefeller Foundation Bellagio Center
The Rockefeller Foundation Bellagio Center is widely recognized as a global hub for collaboration, innovation, and social impact.
Its mission is to bring together leaders from different sectors, disciplines, countries, and perspectives to:
• Develop innovative solutions.
• Create transformative partnerships.
• Advance social and economic progress.
• Address global challenges.
• Promote sustainable development.
• Improve the well-being of vulnerable and underserved populations.
For over 60 years, the Bellagio Center has been a place where leaders come together to think boldly, collaborate meaningfully, and generate breakthrough ideas capable of changing systems at scale.
What Is the Bellagio Center Convening Program?
The Bellagio Center Convening Program supports organizations seeking to bring together carefully selected participants around a specific challenge, opportunity, or solution.
These convenings are designed to:
• Strengthen promising solutions.
• Build cross-sector partnerships.
• Facilitate collaboration.
• Generate actionable outcomes.
• Advance global development goals.
• Create lasting social impact.
The program recognizes that transformative breakthroughs rarely happen in isolation. Instead, they emerge when diverse stakeholders share expertise, challenge assumptions, and collaborate toward common goals.
Global Impact of Bellagio Convenings
The Bellagio Center has played a critical role in launching and advancing several globally influential initiatives, including:
Global Energy Alliance (GEA)
A major initiative focused on expanding access to clean and affordable energy globally.
Global Alliance for Vaccines and Immunization (GAVI)
One of the world's most successful public health partnerships, improving access to vaccines worldwide.
CGIAR
A leading global agricultural research partnership focused on food security and sustainable agriculture.
Global Impact Investing Network (GIIN)
An influential initiative promoting investment strategies that generate both social and financial returns.
These examples demonstrate how Bellagio convenings can catalyze major global movements and solutions.

title: The Economic, Social and Cultural Council Registration 2026–2027: How African Civil Society Organizations Can Gain African Union Recognition and Participate in Continental Policy Dialogue
summary: The African Union’s Economic, Social and Cultural Council (ECOSOCC) has officially opened registration for organizations seeking to join the ECOSOCC Connect platform, a major continental initiative designed to strengthen the participation of African civil society and diaspora organizations in Africa
description:
The African Union’s Economic, Social and Cultural Council (ECOSOCC) has officially opened registration for organizations seeking to join the ECOSOCC Connect platform, a major continental initiative designed to strengthen the participation of African civil society and diaspora organizations in African Union policymaking and development processes.
Through ECOSOCC Connect, organizations across Africa and the diaspora can create official profiles, apply for accreditation, participate in African Union consultations, and contribute directly to continental dialogue on governance, development, social transformation, and public policy.
The platform serves as the recognized gateway for African civil society organizations to engage with the African Union and become part of a continent-wide network shaping Africa’s future.
In addition to the ongoing registration process, ECOSOCC has also announced applications for the 5th Permanent General Assembly (5PGA), a key programme aligned with the ECOSOCC Statute and official African Union participation requirements.
ECOSOCC Connect Registration and 5PGA Timeline
Registration Status
• Open for applications and profile creation
5th Permanent General Assembly (5PGA)
• Opening Date: April 28, 2026
• Closing Date: October 29, 2027
Organizations interested in participating in the ECOSOCC General Assembly and broader AU policy activities are encouraged to complete registration early.
What Is ECOSOCC?
ECOSOCC, short for the Economic, Social and Cultural Council, is an official organ of the African Union created to facilitate the participation of African civil society in the work of the African Union.
The platform acts as the institutional bridge between:
• African citizens
• Civil society organizations
• Policymakers
• African Union institutions
• Member states
ECOSOCC ensures that African civil society has a voice in continental decision-making and development strategies.
What Is ECOSOCC Connect?
ECOSOCC Connect is the African Union’s digital platform designed for:
• Civil society registration
• Accreditation management
• Policy participation
• Continental networking
• Organizational visibility
The platform allows eligible organizations to:
• Create official profiles
• Register organizations online
• Track accreditation processes
• Access African Union opportunities
• Participate in consultations and programmes
The initiative represents a major step toward improving transparency, accessibility, and inclusion in African Union civic engagement processes.
Why ECOSOCC Connect Matters for African Civil Society
Civil society organizations play a critical role in advancing democracy, human rights, youth empowerment, development, gender equality, education, public health, and governance across Africa.
However, many organizations face barriers when attempting to engage directly with continental institutions and policymaking spaces.
ECOSOCC Connect addresses this challenge by creating a centralized and officially recognized platform through which organizations can interact with the African Union.
The platform gives organizations:
• Visibility
• Recognition
• Participation opportunities
• Policy engagement channels
• Access to continental networks
Key Benefits of Registering on ECOSOCC Connect
Organizations that register on the platform gain multiple strategic advantages.
1. Continental Recognition
Registered organizations receive formal recognition within the African Union ecosystem.
This recognition strengthens:
• Organiz

description:
The  World Diplomacy Forum (WDF) Bali 2026  is a highly immersive, action-driven global leadership experience designed for emerging leaders, diplomats, and changemakers who are ready to test their abilities in real-world scenarios.
Taking place in Bali, Indonesia, this unique three-day forum goes far beyond a traditional conference. It places participants directly into high-pressure, real-time simulations involving diplomacy, crisis management, negotiation, and strategic decision-making.
Organized by the International School of Leadership and Diplomacy (ISLD), the program is built to develop the next generation of global leaders through experiential learning, global collaboration, and performance-based recognition.
Event Date and Location
•  Dates: August 7–9, 2026
Application Process and Timeline
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, meaning early applicants have a higher chance of securing a spot and accessing scholarship opportunities.
Participants are encouraged to apply as early as possible due to limited slots and competitive scholarship allocation.
What is the World Diplomacy Forum?
The World Diplomacy Forum is not a conventional training or lecture-based program. Instead, it is a:
• Real-time leadership simulation experience
• High-pressure decision-making environment
• Interactive diplomacy and negotiation platform
Participants are placed in dynamic global scenarios where they must:
• Lead negotiations
• Develop policy responses
• Collaborate across cultures
• Present strategic solutions under time constraints
The program is designed to transform how participants perceive leadership, influence, and global engagement.

1. Lead in Real-Time Scenarios
Participants are immersed in situations where their leadership decisions directly influence outcomes.
2. Solve a Global AI Governance Crisis
• Delegates are given 100 minutes to:
• Research a crisis
• Develop a policy response
• Present their solution
3. Compete in “Last Leader Standing”
• A high-stakes competition testing:
• Communication
• Influence
• Confidence
• Leadership presence
Core Leadership Themes
The program is structured around critical leadership competencies, including:
• Strategic decision-making under pressure
• AI governance and policy thinking
• Diplomatic negotiation and influence
• Crisis communication
• Leadership presence and personal impact
These themes are integrated into all simulations, exercises, and evaluations.
Awards and Recognition
Participants are assessed continuously throughout the program by professional facilitators.
Key Awards Include:
• Most Influential Delegate
• The highest individual honor awarded for leadership and influence
• Master of Crisis Leadership

• Aspiring Leader Award
• Honors the most improved participant
• Diplomatic Impact Award
• Recognizes excellence in diplomacy and negotiation
Grand Privilege

• Free access to the Leaders Summit USA 2027

• 50% discount on the Leaders Summit USA 2027

Participants gain far more than theoretical knowledge.
Key Benefits:

• Global network of peers from 50+ countries

title: VV Visionaries Program 2026: Fully Virtual Global Leadership Program for Women Social Impact Leaders

description:
Thank you for your interest in applying for the VV Visionaries program, a partnership between Vital Voices Global Partnership and the Estée Lauder Emerging Leaders Fund, the charitable fund of Estée Lauder, to support the next generation of emerging leaders who are redefining leadership in their everyday lives. Together with the Estée Lauder Emerging Leaders Fund, we aim to champion women leaders across diverse sectors, industries, and experiences who want to create positive social impact in their communities and beyond.
When women advance, the world succeeds. We need leaders across every industry and every community who use their power, influence, and passion to make positive change. And we know that women’s leadership will accelerate progress in our communities, workplaces, boardrooms, and beyond.
About Vital Voices Global Partnership
We are facing the world’s toughest challenges of all time – climate crisis, systemic and widespread racial injustices, violence against women, growing economic divides and inequity, increased instability and much more. The world needs women to help solve the problems that are affecting people in their communities and around the globe.
For over 25 years, Vital Voices Global Partnership has been investing in women leaders addressing these challenges. We know that women aligned with our leadership model lead differently, and we work to celebrate and share what makes their leadership transformational: inclusion, equity, and a commitment to breaking down barriers.  We have cultivated a network of over 47,000 changemakers across 195 countries daring to reimagine a more equitable world for all. We proudly serve as “venture catalysts”, identifying women leaders with a bold vision for change and partnering with them to make their vision a reality. We help them scale and accelerate their impact through long-term investments to expand their skills, connections, capacity, and visibility.
Program Description:
VV Visionaries program participants will:
• Join a cohort of 50 women leaders committed to advancing their leadership for the greater good.
• Complete the Vital Voices Leadership Journey, a 7-week virtual leadership development course based on learnings from over 25 years of work with leaders from across the world.
• Participate in interactive small-group discussions and peer learning
• Learn from guest speakers including Estée Lauder executives and Vital Voices network.
• Share, learn, and build lasting connections with a cohort of 50 leaders from across the world.
Through the program, participants will:
• Gain a stronger understanding of what drives their leadership; gain a deeper awareness of how to lead inclusive communities; and embrace taking bold actions to create a lasting impact.
• Join the Vital Voices global network of more than 47,000 women leaders from around the world with full access to our network Hub with ongoing continuing education and engagement opportunities.
• After the program, participants will receive a certificate of completion.
Selection Criteria:
The Vital Voices Visionaries program seeks to identify and support exceptional women leaders who have bold ideas and are driving meaningful change. We are not simply selecting résumés — we are selecting community-informed leaders with a clear purpose that make a difference.

•  Innovative Problem Solving:  Challenges the statu
